verdicts.freshman: SKIPPED_BY_DESIGN (recruits have no college PBP history)

coverage_finding: Contextual tags (paint/brk/2ch/offto/FOULED) exist only 2020+; 2015-2018 feeds are box-event-only (paint share of tagged FGA 0.000 vs >=0.41 every 2020+ season). Gated via compute.rs::pbp_lacks_context_tags.

game_models.setup: shared chronological last-20%-of-2026 holdout (n=925), 12-season train (n=46791), production hyperparams, matrix built once with PBP_FEATURES=1, baseline = column subset
game_models.note: diff_pbp_perimeter_fg_pct ranked 10/56 by importance while margin accuracy degraded - importance is not value

trajectory.setup: LOPO over 11 pairs, identical corpus (n=24,592 = sum of per-pair n's in the LOPO output), -1 missing sentinel, raw-rate and within-season-percentile encodings

archetypes.setup: combined 12-season cohort (36,536 player-seasons), +5 style axes (transition/2ch/offTO/fouls per40, paint FG%), nan-mean imputation for pre-2020
archetypes.note: pre-2020 inflation + post-2020 degradation = mean-imputation era artifact; coverage wall unfixable at source

disposition: Tier-1 closes serving-only. PBP_FEATURES plumbing kept gated off in features.py; experiment scripts kept as re-test harness. Membership-derived features (on/off, lineup_quality, RAPM) remain the PBP model play, gated on Tier-2 source lock.
